subject: ist-f
title: (R)IST.F.------ALT.FT.
description: Diagram in AE(PD)-23 (Aspect Essence / Perception Dynamics, Level One) accompanying Braxton's call: 'the resolidification of composite activism is directly related to the nature of the next transformation (that being, the realness that the coming transformation can only be shaped — not stopped). The nature of the meta-reality position of western information dynamics must be re-examined now — for the particulars of its dynamic misinterpretations permeate the whole of western culture, from our relationship to creativity as well as our understanding of functionalism.' (R)IST-F (the reality of isolated focus) is crossed with ALT-FT (alternative functionalism): the question is what isolated-focus produces in its actual instantiation when crossed with alternative-functionalism. HI-P (high purpose) sits upper-center. INFO-SOLD (information solidification), PART (participation), POL-DY (political dynamics), and PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) form the upper-right output cluster. EXT-DY (extended dynamics) branches from the main line to the upper left; SCI-DY (scientific dynamics) branches from its line, and APL-DT (application dictates) from the SCI-DY line. WO-UNF (world unification) anchors the left margin. ALT-FT itself is the partner. MOT-DY and DYM-SPT (dynamic spiritualism) form the lower-center cluster: MOT-DY branches from the main line, WO-UNF from the MOT-DY line, SOC-RT-DY from the WO-UNF line, and DYM-SPT from the SOC-RT-DY line. SOC-RT-DY (social-reality dynamics) anchors the lower-left.
